title: 第1447章 还债第1446章 你什么牌子的狗
slug: 被逐出宗门后师尊师姐后悔终生
content_zh:
“这么大的事，你怎么不早说？”
周通的声音突然响起，在对方的耳畔回响！
黄远刹那一惊，脸上露出了惊骇的神色。
待他回头时，整个人彻底僵住了！
“怎么可能，我莫非是在做梦，你为什么能自己走下来！”
他像是见到了鬼，一颗心脏扑通扑通的狂跳着，从来都没有这么的刺激过。
不对劲，这太不对劲了！
一个圣人级别的小虫子，为什么能从圣王大圣级别强者主持的大阵中挣脱出来？
巧合？这纯粹是开玩笑！
亦或者说动用了秘宝？也说不通，即便他有通天的法宝，自身的实力也太弱了，根本无法催动，更别说挣脱桎梏了！
就连他贵为大圣，想要从阵眼中出来也要用尽手段，勉强为之。
而看对方的神情，好像根本不费力气，如吃饭喝水那般简单，仿佛这搜魂大阵就是他家开的！
照他判断，若是要靠硬实力硬顶，没有接近准帝的修为，不可能走下祭台！
“你…你怎么做到的？”
“啥？你是不是眼瞎，我就是那样走下来的，难不成是蹦下来的吗？”
周通耸了耸肩膀，漫不经心的说道，仿佛刚刚做了一件无足轻重的事情。
“放屁，你这是一派胡言，你一定是动用了什么鬼魅伎俩，竟然还敢在我面前装蒜，信不信我把你碎尸万段！”
他厉声的咆哮道，只觉得自己的智商受到了侮辱，这个小爬虫居然还敢阴阳怪气，分明是没把他这个大圣放在眼里。
真以为自己暂时受困，就收拾不了他了吗？
“你叫你妈呢！”

周通毫不客气，一巴掌扇了过去，依旧是圣人的力道，侮辱性极强！
“啊！！你这畜生，居然敢对我无礼！”
黄远的心态彻底崩了，都说虎落平阳被犬欺，龙游浅滩遭虾戏，以前他还嗤之以鼻，强者就是强者，哪怕死了，也比那些低贱的弱鸡高贵一万倍。
今天他总算是体会到了这种滋味，他恨，他怒，遭受如此奇耻大辱，即便事后清算，将周通碎尸万段挫骨扬灰，也难解此刻的愤懑！
“我要让你万劫不复！”
他狂吼道，身上光辉灿烂，竟然交织成一道烈阳，即将脱困而出，出重击向周通！
“快闪开，你扛不住他！”
玄华心神震动，你开口提醒周通。
“闪开，我看没有那个必要！”
周通毫不在意，看向了祭坛的方向，“既然空位已经出现了，就必须进行顶替吧？”
此话一出，几人顿时一愣，黄远似乎想到了什么，刹那间脸色煞白。
“对啊，怎么把这给忘了，诸位，随我一同发力，将他送上去！”
“玄华，你想干什么，我劝你最好想清楚…”
对方彻底不淡定了，开始无能狂怒了起来。
只是可惜，另外几人身为反抗军的高层，早就将脑袋拴在了裤腰带上，毕竟不是吓大的，在这一刻心有灵犀，同时发力！
嗡的一声，大阵颤动，祭台上爆发出了强大的吸力，全部对转向了黄远。
“不！！”
content_en:
"Why didn't you tell me about such a big thing earlier?"
Zhou Tong's voice suddenly sounded, echoing in the other party's ears!
Huang Yuan was startled for a moment, with a look of horror on his face.
When he turned around, his whole body froze completely!
"How is it possible? I must be dreaming. Why can you walk down by yourself!"
He seemed to have seen a ghost, and his heart was beating wildly. He had never been so excited before.
Something is wrong, this is so wrong!
How could a little saint-level insect break free from the formation presided over by a powerful person like the Holy King and the Great Sage?
coincide? This is purely a joke!
Or maybe a secret treasure was used? It doesn't make sense. Even if he has a magic weapon that reaches the sky, his own strength is too weak to activate it at all, let alone break free from the shackles!
Even if he is a great sage, he has to use all possible means to get out of the formation and do it reluctantly.
And looking at the other party's expression, it seemed that it took no effort at all, it was as simple as eating and drinking, as if this soul-searching array was run by his family!
According to his judgment, if he had to rely on hard power to gain the upper hand, he would not be able to step off the altar without a cultivation level close to that of a quasi-emperor!
"You...how did you do that?"
"What? Are you blind? I walked down like that. Could it be that I jumped down?"
Zhou Tong shrugged his shoulders and said casually, as if he had just done something insignificant.
"Fart, you are talking nonsense. You must have used some evil trick to dare to pretend to be stupid in front of me. Believe it or not, I will cut you into pieces!"
He roared sternly, feeling that his intelligence was insulted. This little reptile actually dared to act strangely. He clearly didn't take the great sage like him seriously.
Do you really think that you can't deal with him if you are temporarily trapped?
"You called you mom!"
Zhou Tong was not polite and slapped him with the strength of a saint, which was extremely insulting!
"Ah!! You beast, how dare you be rude to me!"
Huang Yuan's mentality was completely shattered. It was said that a tiger would be bullied by a dog when he was on the plain, and a dragon would be tricked by a shrimp when traveling in the shallows. He used to sneer at it. The strong is the strong. Even if he dies, he is still 10,000 times more noble than those lowly weak chickens.
Today he finally experienced this feeling. He hated and was angry. He suffered such a shame and humiliation. Even if Zhou Tong's corpse was cut into thousands of pieces and his bones were thrown into ashes after the reckoning, it would be difficult to explain his anger at this moment!
"I will make you irrecoverable!"
He roared wildly, and the radiant light on his body actually intertwined into a blazing sun. He was about to escape from the trap and strike Zhou Tong hard!
"Get out of the way, you can't handle him!"
Xuanhua's mind was shaken, and you spoke to remind Zhou Tong.
"Get out of the way, I don't think it's necessary!"
Zhou Tong didn't care and looked in the direction of the altar, "Since the vacancy has appeared, it must be replaced, right?"
As soon as these words came out, several people were stunned. Huang Yuan seemed to have thought of something, and his face turned pale in an instant.
"Yes, why did you forget this? Everyone, please work with me to send him up!"
"Xuanhua, I advise you to think clearly about what you want to do..."
The other party lost all composure and began to become helpless and furious.
It's just a pity that the other few people, as senior leaders of the resistance, have already tied their heads to their belts. After all, they are not scared. At this moment, they have a clear understanding and exert their strength at the same time!
There was a buzzing sound, the formation trembled, and a powerful suction force erupted from the altar, and everyone turned towards Huang Yuan.
"No!!"
